title: GPT-5.5 Pro solves Erdős problem #38; solution human-checked, Lean-formalised and recorded as solved on erdosproblems.com
summary: GPT-5.5 Pro solved Erdős problem #38; human-checked 26 Apr 2026, Lean-formalised by Aristotle 1 May, recorded as solved on erdosproblems.com
account: Erdős problem #38, an open question in additive number theory asking for a set B that is not an additive basis yet raises the Schnirelmann density of every set A, was solved by OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Pro. On 25 April 2026 a user (gebyjaff) posted the model's solution on the erdosproblems.com forum, with a PDF cleanup by Liam Price; on 26 April forum commenter Nat Sothanaphan reported that a standard check found no issues in the write-up, and on 1 May the Aristotle system autoformalised the argument in Lean, which Sothanaphan confirmed matches the paper. Site maintainer Thomas Bloom added an alternative sketch on 2 May 2026, and the problem page now records the positive solution by GPT 5.5 Pro. Terence Tao's wiki lists it as an AI-standalone full solution.
purpose: General-purpose reasoning model prompted to solve an open research problem
system: GPT-5.5 Pro, with Aristotle used for Lean autoformalisation
developer: OpenAI (GPT-5.5 Pro); Aristotle (developer not named in the cited sources)

ratings.reason: Small: one more entry resolved in the erdosproblems.com project, accepted by its maintainer
Small: a single open problem settled; the problem page records the solution and Tao's wiki catalogues it among many AI contributions

ai_role.statement: The model produced the proof after a human prompt; humans cleaned up the write-up, checked it, and the maintainer accepted it; a separate AI system (Aristotle) produced the Lean formalisation that a human confirmed matches the paper. Tao's wiki classifies the case as AI standalone with non-significant human involvement. The attribution of GPT-5.5 Pro to OpenAI rests on the chatgpt.com share link in gebyjaff's forum post; no cited source names OpenAI in prose. The cited sources do not name Aristotle's developer.
